definitions.full: H422. alah II. אָלָה verb swear, curse (compare I. אלה ? so Thes Lag Or ii. 3 ) — Qal Perfect 1Kin 8:31 ( = 2Chr 6:22 all Vrss Th Bö Bä Kp reading וְאָלָה ); אָלִית Judg 17:2 ; Infinitive absolute אָלֹה Hosea 4:2 ; אָלוֺת 10:4 . 1 swear, take oath before God 1Kin 8:31 ( = 2Chr 6:22 ); in covenants Hosea 4:2 ; 10:4 (falsely). 2 curse Judg 17:2 . Hiph`il Imperfect וַיּאֶֹל 1Sam 14:24 ; Infinitive לְהַאֲלֹתוֺ 1Kin 8:31 2Chr 6:22 adjure, put under oath.
